description: This file contains a Java class `GestureListener` that extends `GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener`. It handles various user gesture events such as taps, long presses, scrolls, flings, and double taps, primarily for an Android application. The class logs gesture information with detailed touch type descriptions.

classes.name: GestureListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling gesture events in an Android application, providing detailed logging of gesture types and touch tools.

methods.name: onSingleTapUp
methods.description: Handles single tap up gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long press gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onFling
methods.description: Handles fling gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onShowPress
methods.description: Handles show press gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onDown
methods.description: Handles down (touch) gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onDoubleTap
methods.description: Handles double tap gesture and logs the event.

methods.name: onDoubleTapEvent
methods.description: Handles mid-events within a double tap, logging the event.

methods.name: onSingleTapConfirmed
methods.description: Handles confirmed single tap event and logs it.

methods.name: getTouchType
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string about the tool type used in the MotionEvent.

methods.name: getButtonsPressed
methods.description: Returns a string listing all stylus buttons pressed during the MotionEvent.
